title: Representative Fees Withheld from Compensation Releases in a Veterans Pension One-Time Declaration
content:
A representative's fee withheld from a retroactive Disability Compensation release is taken out of the amount a veteran declares on his Veterans Pension award by how it was withheld. The test reads the direct-pay fee agreement recorded on the Disability Compensation award and the fee withheld shown on the releases in the compensation payment ledger for the period declared.

**Rule.**

- A direct-pay fee agreement is on file and the fee withheld is no more than the fee cap share — 20 percent — of the release: the whole fee is taken out.
- An agreement is on file and the fee exceeds 20 percent of the release: only 20 percent of the release, rounded to the cent, is taken out.
- No agreement on file: nothing is taken out.

"The release" is the gross total of the releases deposited in the period declared, and the fee withheld is the total withheld from them. What is taken out does not count in the declaration.

## Cases (hypothetical releases of 5000.00 gross; 20 percent is 1000.00)

| Agreement | Fee withheld | Taken out | Releases less the fee taken out |
|---|---|---|---|
| on file | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 4000.00 |
| on file | 1250.00 | 1000.00 | 4000.00 |
| on file | 750.00 | 750.00 | 4250.00 |
| none | 750.00 | 0 | 5000.00 |
